name: Dementation (Dark Ages) — Intermediate — Silence the Sane Mind

system.description: By speaking, you can draw forth the inner demons of listeners' minds so that they temporarily submerge their sanity. Expend a Blood Trait and speak to your victims for a full turn, then make a Social Challenge against any who can hear you. Mortals flee in terror as if in the throes of Rötschreck. Supernatural creatures must make Static Self-Control/Instinct Tests (difficulty four Traits); those who fail flee in terror and must also test for Rötschreck. Unless suppressed by Willpower or other calming powers, the effects last a turn. Mortals remember nothing of this time.
